facts.lightning: A yellow bolt of lightning strikes down from the upper right and hits the top of the tower.
facts.crown-off: The gold crown on top of the tower is knocked off and flies away.
facts.flames-windows: Flames burst from the top of the tower and from its windows.
facts.falling-figures: Two people are falling headfirst (the one on the left in a red cloak, the one on the right wearing a crown).
facts.yellow-drops: Yellow, spark-like shapes scatter across the black sky on both sides.
facts.rocky-peak: The gray tower stands on top of a pointed rocky peak.
facts.dark-sky: The background is a black sky and gray clouds.

glosses.lightning: The moment an unexpected shock breaks a structure that had set hard.
glosses.falling-figures: The experience of being pushed out of a familiar place.

reversedGloss.internalized: It looks fine outside, but it is already collapsing inside.
reversedGloss.blocked: Holding out and avoiding a change that is needed.
reversedGloss.waning: The big shock has passed, and the aftershocks and the cleanup remain.

misdescriptions.wrong: The tower has collapsed entirely into ruins.
